nodes.label: V5 second-order differential correlation shift dm2
nodes.rationale: E2 about the sealed RHF determinant in the sealed object's own orbitals; the filed number per row is dm2 and dm2/m. Single excitations are included explicitly because Brillouin fails for average-of-configuration, and the core-core term is computed on both sides since the core relaxes (J2: each side its own stationary object, no frozen-core shortcut).

nodes.label: Box-discretised virtual spectrum on the sealed mesh
nodes.rationale: Route-A discipline: no Sturmian, no B-splines, because the grid basis is the sealed object's own basis and no new mathematical object may enter. The mesh IS the box (rmax 300 a.u.), and E_cut swept 20/50/100 Ha is the convergence lever — the lever must move the output before any row is filed.

nodes.label: V5 is an estimate, not a bound
nodes.rationale: dm2 cannot certify criterion 3; it converts '(iii) not bounded' into 'estimated to second order with a literature-calibrated 10-40% envelope'. A rigorous bound would need the third-order remainder, which no route on the chain supplies, and T4 must say so.

nodes.label: V5 can-fail set (CF-A lever-dead to CF-D relaxation)
nodes.rationale: Cases taken from OUTSIDE the instrument: E_cut=0 must give E2=0 exactly, He must land within 10% of the textbook MP2 value -0.0374 Ha, doubling the integrals must double E2 exactly, and the core-core term must differ between sides.
